items.title: A December Rate Hike Looks Likely: Buy These 3 Dividend Growers Before the Fed Moves
items.summary: Traders are betting heavily on another Fed hike, and a flat dividend quietly loses ground to inflation and cash yields. Three blue-chip payers have outpaced rising prices, but one of them carries a worrying balance sheet quirk worth understanding first.

items.title: Western Union’s USDPT Stablecoin Becomes a Settlement Option on Visa, Anchorage Digital Says
items.summary: Anchorage Digital said Visa partners can now pay their VisaNet balances in USDPT, the Western Union token its bank mints. Visa has not put out its own statement.

items.title: Anchorage Digital’s Stablecoins Can Now Settle Payments on Visa’s Network
items.summary: Visa and eligible companies can now use Western Union’s USDPT—issued and custodied by the federally chartered Anchorage Digital Bank—to settle VisaNet obligations.
